questions.question: Find the line that will cause a NullReferenceException at runtime.
questions.explanation: Line 8 (index 7) calls AddForce on a potentially null Rigidbody if the GameObject lacks a Rigidbody component. Always check for null or use [RequireComponent].

questions.question: Find the line that will cause the object not to move as expected.
questions.explanation: Line 5 (index 4) moves the object by a constant amount each frame, making movement frame‑rate dependent. It should multiply by Time.deltaTime.

questions.question: Find the line that will result in a missing reference at runtime.
questions.explanation: Line 5 (index 4) assumes GameObject.Find returns a valid object. If there is no GameObject named exactly "Player" in the scene, player will be null and accessing .transform will throw a NullReferenceException.

questions.question: Find the line that prevents the child from following the parent correctly.
questions.explanation: Line 6 (index 5) manually sets the child's world position, which breaks the natural parent‑child relationship. Parenting should be handled by the Hierarchy; moving the parent automatically moves the child.
